info.tagline: Slow-fermented bread, fine pastry and cakes made to order.
info.statement: One jar of starter, one borrowed oven, and a rule that has not changed: bake *small batches*, use real butter, and never sell yesterday's bread.
info.about1: Zav began baking at home for friends. The bread was fermented slowly for flavor, and the pastry was laminated by hand, one fold at a time.
info.about2: Today every loaf, croissant and cake is still made in limited quantity and baked the same morning it is collected.
info.order1: Bread and pastries are baked to a daily count. Message by 20:00 the evening before to reserve for the next morning.
info.order2: Custom cakes need three days. Share the size, flavor and date, and Zav will confirm the price.
info.menuNote: Menu, prices and pictures are sample content. Replace them with your own before sharing.
